status: First pass, 18 October 2026: the character of the enemy air staff (docs/air_war/02_AIR_STAFF.md).
source: sam3d (design); the habits are drawn from the period's air campaigns in docs/research/ENEMY_AIR_RESEARCH_2026-10.md (predictable routes and timing: dtic_linebacker; feints and decoys: decoys; rushed plans: hgram_080) and from nemesis_gdc_2018 and xcom2_wotc (strengths and weaknesses the player learns)
notes: Every officer has eight traits (0..1): boldness, methodical, creativity, rigidity, ambition, skepticism, vindictiveness, composure; and six skills (0..1): planning, intelligence, sead, airmanship, leadership, politics. Quirks are habits with named effects on his choices (simcore/air_war/data.hpp KnownQuirkEffects). Each has the signature the player can see in the raids and the phrase our analysts use once they have seen enough. tier_weight: how often a generated officer of that kind of air force has it (0: never). roles: who can have it.

traits.boldness: accepts risk for results; presses on; approves costly packages
traits.methodical: suppresses and looks before striking; coordinates SEAD and strike well; learns carefully
traits.creativity: tries untried ways, deceives, varies the routes
traits.rigidity: holds to the doctrine and the plan; learns slowly from losses
traits.ambition: wants visible results for the superiors; risks for promotion
traits.skepticism: doubts the pilots' claims and the agents; wants proof
traits.vindictiveness: remembers the unit that shot down the squadron's crews
traits.composure: keeps a clear head under losses (stress spoils every skill less)

quirks.name: dawn raider
quirks.description: Times raids for first light: the defenders tired, the light low behind the attackers.
quirks.signature: Raids arrive at first light.
quirks.intel_hint: favours dawn raids

quirks.name: dusk raider
quirks.description: Likes the last light: the sun behind, the night to get home in.
quirks.signature: Raids arrive at dusk.
quirks.intel_hint: favours raids at dusk

quirks.name: night owl
quirks.description: Flies at night whenever the aircraft allow it.
quirks.signature: Raids come at night.
quirks.intel_hint: prefers to raid at night

quirks.name: daylight man
quirks.description: Wants to see what he hits: raids in full daylight.
quirks.signature: Raids come in the middle of the day.
quirks.intel_hint: raids in broad daylight

quirks.name: creature of habit
quirks.description: Uses the same way in again and again once it has worked.
quirks.signature: Raids keep coming in through the same corridor.
quirks.intel_hint: uses the same entry corridor again and again

quirks.name: pattern breaker
quirks.description: Never comes in the same way twice running.
quirks.signature: Every raid comes from a different direction.
quirks.intel_hint: varies the direction of every raid

quirks.name: feint artist
quirks.description: Shows a small group elsewhere minutes before the main raid.
quirks.signature: A pair of aircraft appears from another direction and turns back just before the main raid.
quirks.intel_hint: opens with a feint from another direction

quirks.name: decoy man
quirks.description: Sends decoys first to make the radars radiate and the launchers fire (the Bekaa, 1982).
quirks.signature: Decoys come first, then the real raid.
quirks.intel_hint: sends decoys ahead to draw our radars on

quirks.name: low-level purist
quirks.description: Believes in coming in under the radars, whatever the guns.
quirks.signature: Raids come in at treetop height.
quirks.intel_hint: insists on low-level attacks

quirks.name: medium-altitude man
quirks.description: Keeps above the guns and trusts suppression to deal with the missiles.
quirks.signature: Raids come in at medium altitude, above the guns.
quirks.intel_hint: keeps his raids above the light flak

quirks.name: massed blows
quirks.description: Few, large, simultaneous raids (the Soviet simultaneous strike: mai_tactics_vvs).
quirks.signature: Big raids, all at once, then quiet.
quirks.intel_hint: strikes in massed, simultaneous blows

quirks.name: drip feeder
quirks.description: Many small raids, one after another (the successive strikes of mai_tactics_vvs).
quirks.signature: Pairs and fours, one after another, all day.
quirks.intel_hint: keeps up a drip of small raids

quirks.name: weather gambler
quirks.description: Flies in weather others would cancel for.
quirks.signature: Raids come in bad weather.
quirks.intel_hint: does not let the weather stop him

quirks.name: ARM hoarder
quirks.description: Keeps the scarce anti-radiation missiles back for the big day (HARM was in short supply: afmag_1989_slam).
quirks.signature: Little SEAD with the ordinary raids.
quirks.intel_hint: is sparing with his anti-radiation missiles

quirks.name: finisher
quirks.description: Goes back to what he has struck until he is sure it is dead.
quirks.signature: The same target is struck again and again.
quirks.intel_hint: returns to finish what he has struck

quirks.name: leads from the front
quirks.description: Flies the important missions himself.
quirks.signature: The lead aircraft of the big raids talks like the man in charge.
quirks.intel_hint: leads his raids in person

quirks.name: by the book
quirks.description: The doctrine's plan, whatever happened yesterday.
quirks.signature: The raids follow the textbook to the letter.
quirks.intel_hint: plans strictly by the book

quirks.name: paper tiger
quirks.description: Reports more success to his superiors than his crews achieved.
quirks.signature: The enemy's claims are far beyond what we lost.
quirks.intel_hint: inflates his results to his superiors

quirks.name: grudge holder
quirks.description: Never forgets a unit that shot down his men.
quirks.signature: The battery that hurt them most is hunted.
quirks.intel_hint: has a score to settle with whoever shoots down his crews

quirks.name: loose lips
quirks.description: His staff talks on open channels; his raids are announced before they fly.
quirks.signature: Our intercepts give warning of his raids hours ahead.
quirks.intel_hint: lets his raids be heard coming on the radio

quirks.name: stopwatch
quirks.description: Every time on target to the minute.
quirks.signature: Raids arrive exactly on the hour or half hour.
quirks.intel_hint: keeps his times on target to the minute

quirks.name: ragged timing
quirks.description: Never quite on time: suppression and strike drift apart.
quirks.signature: The suppression and the bombers arrive minutes apart.
quirks.intel_hint: cannot keep his suppression and his bombers together

quirks.name: double tap
quirks.description: A second strike on the same target soon after the first.
quirks.signature: A second, smaller raid half an hour after the first.
quirks.intel_hint: follows his raids with a second strike on the same target

quirks.name: ELINT believer
quirks.description: Takes every electronic fix as gospel, ghosts included.
quirks.signature: Strikes on empty ground where a decoy emitter was.
quirks.intel_hint: trusts electronic fixes blindly

quirks.name: imagery man
quirks.description: Won't strike a mobile target without fresh imagery (the lesson of Dugman 5).
quirks.signature: Reconnaissance flights before every strike on a mobile target.
quirks.intel_hint: wants fresh photographs before striking anything that moves

quirks.name: loss-shy
quirks.description: Turns his raids back at the first loss.
quirks.signature: Raids turn back after the first aircraft is shot down.
quirks.intel_hint: turns his raids back at the first loss

quirks.name: press-on
quirks.description: Presses on to the target whatever it costs.
quirks.signature: Raids press on through heavy losses.
quirks.intel_hint: presses his raids home whatever the losses

quirks.name: helicopter man
quirks.description: Believes in armed helicopters along the front.
quirks.signature: Helicopters pop up along the front.
quirks.intel_hint: uses his helicopters aggressively

quirks.name: helicopter sceptic
quirks.description: Keeps the helicopters away from the guns.
quirks.signature: Helicopters are rarely seen.
quirks.intel_hint: keeps his helicopters back

quirks.name: suppression first
quirks.description: No strike without suppression and a look first.
quirks.signature: Every raid has suppression aircraft ahead of it.
quirks.intel_hint: never strikes without suppression ahead

quirks.name: gambler
quirks.description: Takes long odds for a big result.
quirks.signature: Costly raids on well-defended targets.
quirks.intel_hint: takes long odds for a big result
